concepts.label: cbstats latency/count histogram format
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - same mechanism minted from cbstats-kvtimings.md in this batch; raw's 'timings' example uses the identical bucketed-range histogram shape for unrelated scheduler/command counters (access_scanner, checkpoint_remover, store_cmd).

notable_absence.finding: The page states 'For internal use only' but never says what makes the command internal-only, which internal component or diagnostic workflow actually consumes 'raw', or what other arguments besides 'timings' are valid - the single Options row just says 'argument | The subcommand to pass through to the raw command,' with no enumeration of what those subcommands are.

cross_component_finding: The access_scanner_* and checkpoint_remover_* histogram families surfaced here name the same subsystems whose enabled/interval settings appear as plain config values on cbstats-config.md (ep_access_scanner_enabled, ep_chk_remover_stime) in this same batch - 'raw timings' is effectively the latency-distribution view of mechanisms that 'config' only reports the on/off and interval settings for.
cross_product_finding: Not applicable - no cross-product content on this page.
